senses.gloss: f. (= שפרפ׳, v. שׁוֹפָר) [something round.] tube; ש׳ של ביצה egg-shell.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:1">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. <he>היתה מביאה ש׳ וכ׳</he> she took an egg-shell and filled it with balsam, v. <cite ref="U01375"><he>שַׁלְפּוּחִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 57b:6">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>עשו לה ש׳ של קנה וכ׳</he> they made for it (the dislocated and detached hip-bone) a tube of reed (to support it), and the hen recovered.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:17">Kel. XVII, 17</cite> <he>ש׳ הקש</he> a straw tube.
Snh. 68ᵃ, a. fr. כמכחול בש׳, v. מַכְחוֹל; a. fr.—ש׳ הנוד or ש׳ the tube (mouth-piece) of the leather bottle.
